metadata.description: Template for manual translation of missing keys. Fill in the translations for each locale.
metadata.instructions: 1. Translate each key from English to the target language. 2. Keep placeholders like {{variable}} unchanged. 3. Save the file when complete.

app_agentsProRequired.en: Expert agents are part of Pro. Get your one-time license to unlock all 30+ agents.

app_backupNeverWarning.en: No backup yet — export one to protect your vault.

app_bmfKitError.en: Could not save the recovery kit. Retry, or create the vault to skip it (you can export anytime from Settings → Storage).

app_diskBackupDesc.en: Automatically save an encrypted daily backup to a folder on your device — clearing browser data can never destroy your vault.

app_diskBackupNotSupported.en: This browser can't choose a folder — daily backups are saved to your Downloads folder instead.

app_diskBackupPermissionDenied.en: permission lost — backups will be saved to Downloads

app_diskCopyBlocked.en: External copy: blocked (browser requires user gesture)

app_firstRunStep1Desc.en: Capture any link. It stays on this device.

app_firstRunStep2Desc.en: Documents are where your thinking lives.

app_firstRunStep3Desc.en: Search everything locally — nothing leaves your device.

app_firstRunSubtitle.en: Three steps, and the workspace starts working for you.

app_flashcardsProRequired.en: Flashcard generation is part of Pro. Your existing cards keep working.

app_maintenancePaused.en: Paused until you enable it again

app_maintenanceRunsWhenIdle.en: Runs locally when you are inactive

app_offlineReadyDesc.en: The app is now ready to work offline.

app_p2pProRequired.en: P2P sync is a Pro feature. Upgrade to link your devices.

app_pocketImportStatusSummary.en: Read and archive status will be preserved.

app_v5ResidueNoticeTitle.en: Some vault data still uses the legacy encryption format

backup_bannerStaleDesc.en: Your last backup is over 48 hours old. Your vault may have changed since then — export a fresh copy to stay protected.

cloudRemoteRetentionDescription.en: Older timestamped backups are removed when the provider supports safe deletion.

cloud_restoreIntegrityFailed.en: Integrity check failed: this remote backup was truncated or modified. Restore aborted.

consent_analytics_desc.en: Help us understand how the app is used

consent_description.en: BookmarkForge is privacy-first: all data stays on your device. We need your consent for optional diagnostic features that help us improve the app.

consent_errorReporting_desc.en: Report crashes and errors to help us fix issues

onboarding_recoveryDesc.en: If you've used BookmarkForge before — for example after clearing your browser data — restore your data from a backup file. Otherwise, continue to set up your new vault.

onboarding_restoreError.en: Could not restore the backup. Check the file and password.

privacy_keyPrincipleText.en: BookmarkForge runs 100% locally on your device. Your bookmarks, notes, documents, and AI conversations are stored in your browser's local database and are never transmitted to our servers.

privacy_s1_text.en: BookmarkForge ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your data when you use our application.

privacy_s2_b1.en: No bookmarks or URLs are sent to our servers

privacy_s2_b2.en: No notes or documents leave your device

privacy_s2_b3.en: No AI prompts or responses are logged by us

privacy_s2_b5.en: No personal information is required to use the app

privacy_s2_b6.en: No analytics are collected by default

privacy_s2_intro.en: We want to be clear about what we do not collect:

privacy_s3_closing.en: Your data never leaves your device unless you explicitly export a backup, share your vault, or use a cloud AI provider.

privacy_s3_intro.en: All your data is stored locally in your browser using:

privacy_s4_b3.en: Keys are derived and stored locally in your browser

privacy_s4_closing.en: We do not have access to your encryption keys or passwords.

privacy_s5_b1.en: Runs entirely in your browser. No data leaves your device.

privacy_s5_b2.en: Your prompts are sent directly to the provider. We do not intercept, store, or log these requests.

privacy_s6_b1.en: Download all your data as an encrypted backup at any time

privacy_s6_b2.en: Remove all data from the app settings

privacy_s6_b3.en: We don't have accounts, so there's nothing to delete on our end

securityVaultChangedInAnotherTab.en: The vault changed in another tab. Unlock again to continue.

terms_s1_text.en: By using BookmarkForge, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the application.

terms_s2_b3.en: Use AI-powered features (locally or via cloud providers)

terms_s2_b4.en: Sync data between your devices using peer-to-peer connections

terms_s2_intro.en: BookmarkForge is a local-first knowledge management application that allows you to:

terms_s3_b1.en: BookmarkForge runs entirely in your browser

terms_s3_b2.en: All data is stored locally on your device

terms_s3_b3.en: We do not host, store, or backup your data on our servers

terms_s3_b4.en: You are responsible for backing up your data using the export feature

terms_s4_b1.en: Maintain backups of your important data

terms_s4_b2.en: Keep your vault password secure (we cannot recover it)

terms_s4_b3.en: Use the application in compliance with applicable laws

terms_s5_text.en: BookmarkForge is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for data loss due to browser clearing, hardware failures, or errors in AI-generated content.
